scripts.//postinstall: The Prisma client is generated into node_modules, not committed. Without this, a fresh clone fails to typecheck until someone happens to run a migration — `prisma generate` is what creates the model types. It needs no database and no DATABASE_URL.
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.lint: eslint backend/src backend/scripts backend/prisma backend/prisma.config.ts frontend/src scripts orval.config.ts eslint.config.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run lint:boundaries && npm run test && npm run build
